integrity: The operator equations, nilpotency condition, automorphism group, and conjugation action are reconstructed directly; finite-field enumeration is replay evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats nilpotent weight-zero Rota-Baxter operators on one three-dimensional solvable Leibniz algebra.
The raw complex weight-zero operator classification is prior work; the new scope is nilpotent geometry and automorphism moduli.
title: Nilpotent Rota–Baxter moduli in Mondal–Saha Example 3.5
